test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Rukhsana was left alone in the house again, but fear was now her __constant__ companion.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. changing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"constant"** means something that is continuous and unchanging over time. (निरंतर)

 
 
• **Example: **The constant noise from the construction site made it difficult to concentrate.
 
 
 
• **"Changing" **refers to something that is not stable and is subject to alterations or variations. (बदलते हुए)
 
 
• **Example: **The weather is constantly changing during the spring season.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'constant' **is **'changing'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. changing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Boring **(उबाऊ): Not interesting; tedious.

 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so boring that several students fell asleep.
 
 
 
• **Friendly **(मित्रवत): Kind and pleasant.
 
 
• **Example: **She has a friendly demeanor that makes everyone feel comfortable around her.
 
 
 
• **Steady** (स्थिर): Firmly fixed, supported, or balanced; not shaking or moving.
 
 
• **Example:** The ladder was steady, allowing him to climb safely to the roof.
